newsitem.title: GREECE: Princess Diana on quick private visit to Greece.
newsitem.headline: Princess Diana on quick private visit to Greece.

text.p: Britain's Princess Diana will arrive in Greece on Wednesday for a private visit and attend a funeral on the island of Evia, official sources said.
They said Diana would travel by car from Athens to the town of Limni for the funeral. Evia, one of Greece's largest islands, is northeast of Athens and linked to the mainland by a bridge.
On Wednesday afternoon she will attend the funeral of Yannis Kalyviotis, 27, who died in a London hospital at the weekend.
Diana met Kalyviotis on one of her visits to London hospitals and took an interest in his case, the official sources said. He died of cystic fibrosis, a non-contagious, hereditary disease.
Diana divorced Prince Charles, heir to the British throne, this year. She is due to attend a gala dinner next Tuesday in Washington.
